title: THE SAME SCORE: IMPROVED COSINE BASED BIAS SCORE FOR WORD EMBEDDINGS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring semantic associations in word embeddings using cosine-based scores (e.g., SAME, WEAT) and evaluating downstream bias via True Positive Rate (TPR) Gap in occupation classification (BIOS dataset) and Pseudo Log-Likelihood (PLL) on counterfactual sentences (CrowS-Pairs dataset).
